blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Cebuanos can expect cloudy skies with scattered rain showers and thunderstorms on Thursday, September 17, due to the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ) and a low-pressure area (LPA). These weather conditions may persist until Friday, with fairer weather expected to return over the weekend, Visayas Pagasa Regional Services Division (PRSD) weather specialist Jhomer Eclarino told CDN Digital. Cebu will also experience light to moderate winds and slight to moderate coastal waters throughout Thursday. Temperatures across the province are expected to range from 26 to 31 degrees Celsius.
